bioconda.name: ervmancer
bioconda.summary: Quantifies HERV short read RNA sequencing expression data.
bioconda.description: ERVmancer quantifies Human Endogenous Retrovirus (HERV) short read RNA sequencing expression data by aligning short reads to a curated subset of HERVs and then resolves ambiguity in alignment using a pre-computed HERV phylogenetic tree.
